purpose: Stage1 finite semantic review index. This is documentation, not a runtime registry, generated descriptor implementation or permission to publish unresolved APIs.
decision_reference: stage1_contract_decisions.md: A2 accepted 2026-10-28; other exact new public schemas keep their named owning-stage gates.

scope.selection: Every Python class definition under hotpot/cheminfo is dispositioned. Explicit type lists distinguish chemical interface families, module-visible support, known retirement and private/deployment implementation. Top-level exports remain baseline declared_exports/runtime_surface, not all selected types.
scope.entry_resolution: Resolve an entry by (type,entry) override first, else its explicit type-group contract; an override kind_policies further distinguishes retained read from retired write. Exact signature, default, annotation and read/write syntax come from bound interface_inventory; exact dataclass field order/bases/decorators from bound classes. Inheritance and ordinary/dynamic fields below supplement, not replace, those schemas.
scope.review_status_meaning: scoped_semantics_reviewed means role/owner, existing schema and lifecycle policy have been audited. It does not assert production implementation, exhaustive dynamic-consumer discovery, new API approval, deep immutability or completed later-stage gates.
scope.baseline_vs_target: Statements explicitly marked baseline/current describe existing code. Ownership, permissions and invalidation policies otherwise describe the plan target and must pass the named owning-stage cutover; this table is not a claim those policies already execute.
scope.unchanged_schema_rule: A stable value/protocol/exception family can share no-carrier-dirty policy while retaining each exact schema. No mechanical renaming/merging, generated getter or common base is authorized.
scope.excluded_rule: Private implementation/deployment graph classes retain baseline migration ownership; exclusion from public chemical review is not evidence of dead code or permission to delete.
scope.outer_consumers: Classes outside hotpot/cheminfo remain in the original 782-class inventory/data-object budget; plugin/dataset/pipeline types receive only the chemistry consumer migrations already authorized, not a new application-wide protocol.

carrier.fact_or_dependencies: Atom/Bond membership, typed facts, net declarations, stereo, constraints, source frames and selected typed attachments; no second graph or result authority.
carrier.shape_dtype_unit: Existing signatures and units; source atom order, N atoms/M bonds; native and numeric layouts remain distinct.
carrier.presence_source: Explicit value and source presence are separate; public id is not private UID or current idx.
carrier.read_policy: Return existing carrier handles as handles; numeric factual buffers become independent snapshots under A2/A3.
carrier.write_policy: Existing factual edits enter one complete validate/install/mark transaction. Arbitrary setattr is not a new extension protocol.
carrier.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
carrier.operation: Existing Molecule construction/mutation facades delegate to structure commit and domain operations.
carrier.invalidation_scope: Mark only declared dependent groups; fixed group bits and bounded dirty seeds; no revision counters or generic cache.
carrier.lifecycle: copy/components/merge/removal preserve or explicitly remap owner, identity, presence and source; detached handles cannot silently refer to compacted rows.

atom_facts.shape_dtype_unit: Integer element/charge/H domains and display id, finalized with N01; symbol is a string translation, not another column.
atom_facts.presence_source: Zero is a real supplied value; omission remains distinguishable; supplied H/charge is not overwritten by default valence.
atom_facts.read_policy: Scalar reads project canonical facts; no immediate chemical calculation merely to obtain a fact.
atom_facts.write_policy: Preserve approved scalar aliases; encode overlapping aliases consistently; transaction precedes dependency marking.
atom_facts.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
atom_facts.operation: A1/A2/A4, Stage3 table and Stage5 dependencies.
atom_facts.invalidation_scope: Element/H/charge-sensitive representation/P2/P3 groups; preserve unrelated geometry and components.
atom_facts.lifecycle: Source presence and identity follow complete import/copy/remap; A2 constructor cutover only after all supplied-fact consumers migrate.

net_declaration.owner: Molecule-owned net declaration, separate from per-atom facts
net_declaration.fact_or_dependencies: Existing Molecule.charge; do not equate net declaration with sum of partial charges or selected scientific-state hypothesis.
net_declaration.shape_dtype_unit: Existing integer net-charge domain in e; exact declaration storage and presence finalized at Stage3.
net_declaration.presence_source: Explicit zero remains present; total-charge consistency depends on adequate atom formal-charge coverage.
net_declaration.read_policy: Read declared net value without automatic charge distribution.
net_declaration.write_policy: Existing declaration/update operation validates complete intent; never puts residual charge on an arbitrary atom.
net_declaration.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
net_declaration.operation: Net declaration commit; calc_mol_default_charge/update_mol_charge retain separate full-operation roles.
net_declaration.invalidation_scope: Only charge-dependent representations/results; preserve independent topology and geometry.
net_declaration.lifecycle: Copy/import retain declaration/source; scientific candidates remain independent historical hypotheses.

coordinates.fact_or_dependencies: Atom.coordinates/x/y/z and Molecule.coordinates are the same Cartesian values.
coordinates.shape_dtype_unit: Atom (3,), Molecule (N,3), float64, angstrom; scalar axes share the same block.
coordinates.presence_source: Characterized zero-coordinate construction defaults remain; caller-supplied presence recorded separately.
coordinates.read_policy: No authoritative writable ndarray alias; return isolation follows A2/A3 contract, not ndarray frozen flags.
coordinates.write_policy: Scalar, batch, translation, load and optimization commit use the same coordinate installation.
coordinates.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
coordinates.operation: structure commit; geometry preparation; explicit conformer_load/optimization operation.
coordinates.invalidation_scope: Only geometry-dependent views/results; topology, explicit stereo and stored source frames persist.
coordinates.lifecycle: Old exported numeric snapshots retain their values; long operation verifies relevant input identity before commit.

identity.owner: Molecule membership and private UID; existing public source labels
identity.fact_or_dependencies: Atom.idx is current row; id is existing display/source id; molecule/mol is owning carrier; endpoint membership is explicit.
identity.shape_dtype_unit: Existing int/string/handle types; do not export UID as lossy float.
identity.presence_source: Source labels/identifier are not chemical identity or scientific-result validity.
identity.read_policy: Existing handle identity remains observable; immutable view member identities remain inspectable even when source calculations are stale.
identity.write_policy: Only already approved id/member edit operations; no new UID setter or arbitrary reparenting.
identity.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
identity.operation: Membership edits, refresh_atom_id, complete importer and copy/remap.
identity.invalidation_scope: Member changes update row mapping, topology index, stereo/constraints/frame indices atomically.
identity.lifecycle: Equal UIDs alone never establish ownership across two Molecules.

reference.owner: reference data plus rules/chemistry or physics
reference.fact_or_dependencies: Element identity and immutable versioned reference values; mass/radius/period/group/electronegativity retain existing formulas.
reference.shape_dtype_unit: Existing per-property units and numeric domains in source; no scientific formula correction in a move.
reference.presence_source: Existing unknown/reference behavior preserved; no new zero-fill interpretation.
reference.read_policy: Read-only derived projections prepared from explicit current facts; no backend execution.
reference.write_policy: No inferred new setter; existing reference helper transformations act on their own data.
reference.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
reference.invalidation_scope: Carrier projections depend on the corresponding atomic facts; independent reference values have no Molecule dirty state.
reference.lifecycle: Reference table ownership is separate from input/returned mutable pandas objects; immutable reference loading splits in Stage3, elemental/classification/electron rules in Stage5.

pure_derived.owner: rules with operation-prepared explicit input; no carrier cache
pure_derived.fact_or_dependencies: Element/electron facts, topology and/or geometry as required by the named existing formula.
pure_derived.shape_dtype_unit: Keep current hyb, oxidation_state heuristic, sums, graph/path order and units; these are not calculator scientific-state selection.
pure_derived.presence_source: Insufficient input or conflict uses the declared group outcome; scientific uncertainty is not automatically an exception.
pure_derived.read_policy: Pure dependency preparation may occur once on a dirty read; no models/download/GPU/external optimization in result getters.
pure_derived.write_policy: Derived n/s/p/d/f/g/electron_configuration/valence/aromatic projections become read-only with their owning-stage consumers.
pure_derived.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
pure_derived.operation: Stage4 mathematical projection extraction; Stage5 elemental/descriptor/P2 preparation and assignment; calculator scientific-state providers split at Stage8A.
pure_derived.invalidation_scope: Owner checks all upstream pending seeds before CURRENT, including remote-first component reads; views own no dirty truth.
pure_derived.lifecycle: Task paths/rings/angles/distance/spectrum calculations do not become persistent carrier caches.

chemical_assignment.owner: operations with pure rules; Molecule installs proposal
chemical_assignment.fact_or_dependencies: Coupled bond order/aromatic/electron/H/charge representation and explicit source ledger.
chemical_assignment.shape_dtype_unit: Keep existing scientific behavior and result/exception conventions while changing ownership.
chemical_assignment.presence_source: Explicit and inferred source are distinct; unresolved/conflict must retain evidence instead of inventing values.
chemical_assignment.read_policy: Read completed current projections only; returned assignment/proposal/history is not an implicit carrier writer.
chemical_assignment.write_policy: Validate the whole proposal and required owner/content identity, then install once; no setter-order reconstruction.
chemical_assignment.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
chemical_assignment.operation: determine_rings_aromatic, assign_bond_order, hydrogen/valence/charge operations and rule preparation; empty assign_aromatic is deleted under Section9.6.
chemical_assignment.invalidation_scope: Only downstream groups; fields installed by one complete proposal must not invalidate each other.
chemical_assignment.lifecycle: Aromatic/Kekule extraction, coupled assignment and Ring-writer/cache removal occur in Stage5. Separate experimental protocol is Stage13A/B only after validated/reported/committed Stage0-12 B_exp; new branch, D_exp definition commit then I_exp integration commit.

result_projection.owner: one Molecule-owned typed result attachment; operation-produced history
result_projection.fact_or_dependencies: partial charges/MCA and current selected quantities, with explicit subject rows and dependency identity.
result_projection.shape_dtype_unit: partial_charge Optional[float]; MCA existing scalar/site types and kJ/mol; fixed attrs projection float64 19 columns.
result_projection.presence_source: Absent partial charge -> None; absent MCA retains AttributeError; present zero is distinct. A2 fixed export missing slot -> NaN.
result_projection.read_policy: Current direct access checks source validity; stale selected results raise the mapped RuntimeError; historical results keep their content.
result_projection.write_policy: Only complete assignment/attachment and selection operations; no per-Atom duplicate result writer.
result_projection.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
result_projection.operation: Explicit assign_partial_charge/MCA operation; existing feature export has task-specific encoding preserved.
result_projection.invalidation_scope: Only declared inputs, with output validity separated from input provenance; final output must not self-invalidate.
result_projection.lifecycle: A2/A8 Stage7C cutover must preserve source presence and unchanged model input encoding; existing task DTO float fields require migration.

constraints.fact_or_dependencies: Atom x/y/z constraints, Bond/Angle/Torsion constraints and complete bonds/angles constraints.
constraints.shape_dtype_unit: Existing booleans/constraint payloads, source memberships and order.
constraints.presence_source: Unconstrained/absent is not a fabricated measured value.
constraints.read_policy: Views project carrier constraint owner; no independent mutable constraint copy.
constraints.write_policy: Existing constructor/factual constraint input commits with associated facts; clear/edit through owner operation.
constraints.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
constraints.invalidation_scope: Only constraint-dependent tasks/results; geometry is not edited by changing a constraint declaration.
constraints.lifecycle: Membership changes remap or atomically reject constraints; rollback preserves caller state.

bond_representation.owner: Molecule Bond fact owner and unique topology index
bond_representation.fact_or_dependencies: Bond endpoints, bond_kind/bond_order, direction, source and source_metadata form one coherent representation.
bond_representation.shape_dtype_unit: Existing BondKind enum/string values and order domain; directional donor->metal semantics remain directional.
bond_representation.presence_source: Source metadata copy semantics retained; absent direction/source is not an order value.
bond_representation.read_policy: bond_kind is currently read-only; attr_dict includes copied source metadata; no new kind setter.
bond_representation.write_policy: Existing bond_order/creation operations validate coupled kind/order; migrate hidden-edge owners rather than keep parallel graphs.
bond_representation.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
bond_representation.invalidation_scope: Topology/representation-sensitive groups; explicit stereo remapped with edge changes.
bond_representation.lifecycle: Copy/components/merge/working-copy rollback preserve all bond facts, not only numeric order.

view.owner: views; owner Molecule supplies current facts
view.fact_or_dependencies: Immutable member identities plus named topology/geometry dependencies; no cached carrier rings/pairs/angles/torsions.
view.shape_dtype_unit: Existing member order, indices, distance angstrom and Angle/Torsion degrees.
view.presence_source: No local CURRENT/dirty flags; atom membership/source owner is not inferred from row equality.
view.read_policy: Named source-dependent calculations verify source; stale calculation -> RuntimeError; read-only membership remains inspectable.
view.write_policy: Remove Ring/JointRing representation writers at reviewed cutover; full Molecule operation owns mutation. Constraint projections use ConstraintSet.
view.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
view.operation: Stage3 source/identity contracts; Stage4 mathematical views and angle/torsion constraints; Stage5 immutable Ring and writer/cache removal; Stage7B remaining pair/hidden-topology/constraint completion.
view.invalidation_scope: Relevant topology or geometry only; view never marks its own independent dirty state.
view.lifecycle: Detached or source-changed handles cannot silently reuse new row meanings; no new exception class or AtomPairTable alias.

pair_observation.role: pair topology view plus existing supplied scientific observation
pair_observation.owner: views + one typed result attachment; exact split gate Stage7B/7C
pair_observation.fact_or_dependencies: AtomPair endpoints; shortest_path; wiberg_bond_order written by tmQM provider; Atom.frac_valence is likewise supplied scientific data.
pair_observation.shape_dtype_unit: attrs order wiberg_bond_order,length_shortest_path; baseline length_shortest_path is len(path), a vertex count.
pair_observation.presence_source: Baseline Wiberg defaults to numeric 0 and providers also supply real zero/nonzero; do not infer missingness from zero.
pair_observation.read_policy: Preserve value and model pair-feature order from the first Stage4 pair/cache extraction; Stage7B/7C completion cannot justify an earlier loss.
pair_observation.write_policy: Provider writes migrate to complete import plus typed result owner; exact absence/setter schema remains a Stage7B/7C gate.
pair_observation.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
pair_observation.operation: tmQM provider import, update_pairs, AImodels/data_extract and PyG feature projection.
pair_observation.invalidation_scope: Topology path and supplied Wiberg have distinct dependencies; removing a topology cache cannot delete scientific observations.
pair_observation.lifecycle: Complete import preserves supplied values/subject identity; copy/remap follows reviewed P1/P3 classification and Decision19, not unconditional generated-result retention. No new public pair DTO is approved here.

conformers.owner: source frames plus attached generated ensemble; current coordinates remain one owner
conformers.fact_or_dependencies: Nine existing keys; source frames then result attachment order then original ensemble frame order.
conformers.shape_dtype_unit: int item dict coordinates (N,3), slice (K,N,3); existing energy/force/thermo units; no extra persisted coordinate array.
conformers.presence_source: Optional frame quantities remain absent/None; zero-valued scientific outputs remain values.
conformers.read_policy: Read independent numeric values; historical frames retained; baseline constructor typo/empty iteration/partial-write defects are not contracts to reproduce.
conformers.write_policy: add does not implicitly select; load commits current coordinates only; clear removes both source frames and attached ensembles; add/load/clear return None.
conformers.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
conformers.invalidation_scope: Loading coordinates affects geometry-dependent current results; selecting an ensemble frame does not invalidate that ensemble itself.
conformers.lifecycle: Stage7D must characterize and repair atomic failure; detailed defects listed in known_baseline_defects.

crystal.owner: structure/crystal; mathematics conversion and external adapter
crystal.fact_or_dependencies: One six-parameter value a,b,c,alpha,beta,gamma; remove mol/obcell/space_group/lattice_group/LatticeGroup per reviewed plan.
crystal.shape_dtype_unit: a/b/c use input length unit (carrier convention angstrom); angles degrees; alpha rows1/2,beta rows1/3,gamma rows2/3.
crystal.presence_source: Six constructor values are explicit; no new matrix property/setter.
crystal.read_policy: Retain constructor/from_matrix values and characterized convention; baseline six fields are ordinary writable attributes.
crystal.write_policy: Final independent value permissions follow owning-stage review; no automatic new setter from mathematical invertibility.
crystal.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
crystal.invalidation_scope: Independent old value has no Molecule dirty state; replacing host cell marks only cell dependencies.
crystal.lifecycle: No Molecule back-reference or retained backend cell; baseline obcell builds a new OBUnitCell per read.

bundle.owner: MolBundle owns list container, not member facts
bundle.fact_or_dependencies: list_mol is list(input); Molecule members are shared handles.
bundle.shape_dtype_unit: Existing order and to_pyg_dataset output; baseline has no custom __iter__/__len__.
bundle.presence_source: Empty collection is distinct from missing scientific output.
bundle.read_policy: Expose only existing members/collection API; no invented sequence API.

bundle.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
bundle.invalidation_scope: No common carrier dirty owner for a bundle; only owning Molecule facts invalidate their dependencies.
bundle.lifecycle: Container copy does not imply deep Molecule copy.

copy_import.owner: structure record/import builder plus external adapters
copy_import.fact_or_dependencies: Facts, presence/source, stereo, labels, coordinates, constraints and source frames; generated P3 copy/component policy follows Decision19.
copy_import.shape_dtype_unit: Exact source order/schema and explicit owner/UID/index remap; do not reduce input to old numeric columns.
copy_import.presence_source: Source formats provide presence; numeric 0 is not an omission detector.

copy_import.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
copy_import.invalidation_scope: Preserve or remap retained factual dirty scopes, never convert NEEDS_RECALC or CONFLICT into CURRENT; drop generated P3/runtime state on copy as Decision19 specifies.
copy_import.lifecycle: External import/rollback cannot expose partial rows or lose supplied stereo/labels/scientific values. Copy/components/merge follow the separate exact Decision19 table, including dropped generated results and conditional cell/charge/spin handling.

external_facade.fact_or_dependencies: Current structure snapshot and named format/backend/query parameters.

external_facade.presence_source: Preserve source absence/diagnostics; no fabricated successful result.
external_facade.read_policy: Explicit conversion/execution may invoke backend; cid/name/cas remain existing PubChem query conveniences, not retained result getters.
external_facade.write_policy: Backend result installs carrier values only via a declared complete operation.
external_facade.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.

external_facade.invalidation_scope: Only explicit carrier writes mark dependencies; independently returned external values own no Molecule dirty truth.
external_facade.lifecycle: Caller-owned resource/session lifetime remains component-specific; no hidden carrier-held backend object.

thermo.shape_dtype_unit: All 181 declared properties plus existing __getattr__ forwarding; external field units retained.
thermo.presence_source: External library missing/unsupported behavior retained; proxy can contain executable external objects.
thermo.read_policy: Do not replace real broad interface with a small frozen README-derived record.
thermo.write_policy: Existing task proxy behavior retained; only selected pure values enter a separately typed persistent attachment.
thermo.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.

thermo.invalidation_scope: No carrier dirty state inside returned task proxy.
thermo.lifecycle: Not retained as Molecule state; returned external object remains caller-owned, not claimed immutable.

stereo_transport.owner: existing stereo payload schema; sole Molecule factual transport owner
stereo_transport.fact_or_dependencies: Anchor/carrier/descriptor/group/namespace/code; isotope/radical/current and source H; bond display direction.

stereo_transport.lifecycle: Existing returned payload is history; no in-place mutation or per-record dirty cache.

stereo_results.shape_dtype_unit: Exact existing enum codes, result fields and record index order.
stereo_results.presence_source: Unresolved remains issue evidence; is_valid/is_equivalent not a substitute for scientific descriptors.
stereo_results.read_policy: Inspect returned result content without re-reading current Molecule.
stereo_results.write_policy: assign returns payload proposal without modifying Molecule; installation is a separate operation.
stereo_results.encode_decode: Retain the exact existing constructor/field/enum order and only the codecs actually present in the bound source; no invented to_dict or schema normalization.
stereo_results.operation: validate/assign/align preserve current algorithm and return behavior.
stereo_results.invalidation_scope: No result dirty state; application checks required current source identity.
stereo_results.lifecycle: Returned reports do not refresh when source changes; no protected API rename.

native_transport.owner: task-local packing; separate from AtomFactTable and MolecularFacts
native_transport.fact_or_dependencies: Field-selected structure buffers, stereo tables and explicit presence masks.
native_transport.shape_dtype_unit: Contiguous owned writable arrays; indices uint64; kinds/presence uint32; group_id int64; atom isotope/radical/H int32; UTF8 data uint8,offsets/lengths uint64,present uint8.

native_transport.write_policy: Pack explicit snapshot once; borrow only for verified synchronous lifetime with keepalive.

rdwrapper.fact_or_dependencies: ETKDGOptions, CoordinationEmbeddingConstraints, ConformerRecord/Batch, RuntimeInfo and synchronous ETKDGSampler.
rdwrapper.shape_dtype_unit: float64 coordinates (C,N,3) angstrom, stable ordinal/record fields; donor->metal constraints and bounds angstrom.

scientific_facts.role: immutable scientific input snapshot / composed value
